technical_and_design_decisions: Integrate Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka for service registration and state discovery across s-c-s modules and the xd-admin server.
Refactor xd-admin controllers (ContainersController, StreamsController, ModulesController, JobsController) to delegate execution to a pluggable Admin SPI implementation layer.
Utilize Spring Boot Actuator APIs and Spring Integration channels to capture application metrics directly from modules and expose them over REST without xd-container coupling.
Configure Spring Boot metric export infrastructure with Redis as the default storage engine to persist metric snapshots on a 5-second interval.
Refactor legacy Spring XD FTP source modules to target Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) interfaces using Spring Integration FTP adapters.
Set up automated CI build pipelines and Docker image bundling/upload workflows to the 'springcloud/module-launcher' DockerHub repository.
assumptions: Development environment has access to existing Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream repositories.
Required credentials and permissions for DockerHub registry 'springcloud' and target CI servers are available.
Redis infrastructure is available for testing metric persistence functionality.
A single full-stack Java developer will perform all implementation, testing, and CI configuration tasks.

activities.activity_description: Implement Spring Cloud Eureka client integration within s-c-s modules to publish and continuously update module state in Eureka service registry.

activities.activity_name: Refactor XD Admin Controllers to SPI Calls (U2)
activities.activity_description: Refactor ContainersController, StreamsController, ModulesController, and JobsController to invoke underlying deployment-specific Admin SPI implementations.

activities.activity_name: Direct Module Metrics Capture & REST Exposure (U3)
activities.activity_description: Expose module metrics via REST APIs directly using Spring Boot Actuator and Spring Integration channel metrics, removing xd-container dependency.
Configure xd-admin server as a Eureka client to self-register with Eureka server for endpoint discovery.

activities.activity_name: CI Build Setup for s-c-s Repositories (U5)
activities.activity_description: Configure continuous integration job pipelines to automatically compile, unit test, and assemble s-c-s repository commits.

activities.activity_name: Port FTP Modules from XD to s-c-s (U6)
activities.activity_description: Migrate FTP source module implementations from Spring XD code base into s-c-s repository structure for building streaming pipelines.

activities.activity_name: Module Metrics Persistence via Spring Boot Export (U7)
activities.activity_description: Configure Spring Boot export() API to snapshot metrics directly into Redis on a 5-second interval and expose persisted data via REST.
Create automated CI workflow step to build, bundle, and push the module-launcher Docker image to the springcloud DockerHub registry.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of Eureka discovery, REST metrics retrieval, FTP stream source pipeline, and CI pipeline execution.
